children: UK DDoS protection specialist's H1 revenue grew 42% yr/yr, driven by new customer wins
EBITDA improved to $2.6 mln from a loss last year, reflecting higher gross margin
Management expects FY 2026 revenue and EBITDA to exceed market expectations
Company expects FY 2026 revenue to exceed market expectations of $29.2 mln
Company expects FY 2026 EBITDA to significantly exceed market expectations of $3.3 mln
Management expects H2 2026 gross margin to trend towards 90-91%
NEW CUSTOMER WINS AND CONTRACT EXPANSIONS - Co said revenue growth was underpinned by new customer wins and contract expansions
HIGHER-MARGIN SOFTWARE SALES - Gross margin increased due to a higher mix of upfront software licence contracts and success of software-only deployment option
EXPANDED PRODUCT PORTFOLIO AND PARTNER NETWORK - Co attributed order intake growth and market traction to its expanded product portfolio and strengthened channel partner program
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Corero Network Security PLC is GBp16.25, about 91.2% above its September 8 closing price of GBp8.50
The stock recently traded at 46 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 90 three months ago
